entity.name: Bhawesh Bhaskar
entity.description:
I am a software engineer based in India working in Python, TypeScript and Rust. Since October 2026 I have been contributing to open source projects that other developers build on, mostly data and AI infrastructure.

Merged so far: LanceDB (CombinedFieldsQuery for full text search, PR 4691; ZoneMap scalar index in the Python API, PR 4816), supabase-py (realtime channel rejoin schedule, PR 1916; and PR 1885), a2a-python (Windows test fix, PR 1406) and pypa/distlib (PR 289). A bug I reported in FastMCP was fixed in PR 6012 with co-author credit.

Open and under review: LanceDB BloomFilter index for Python (PR 4877) and NGram index for Node.js (PR 4908), pypa/packaging (PR 1482), opentelemetry-python-contrib (PR 5219) and rune (or-patterns in match arms, PR 1055).

I do this work unpaid alongside looking for income. A fellowship would let me spend three months on it full time.

projects.name: LanceDB (contributor)
projects.description: LanceDB is an open source embedded vector database used for search and AI applications. I contribute to its Python and Node.js SDKs. My work so far exposes index types that exist in the Rust core but were missing from the SDKs: CombinedFieldsQuery (merged), ZoneMap scalar index (merged), BloomFilter scalar index (in review) and NGram index for Node.js (in review).

projects.name: supabase-py (contributor)
projects.description: supabase-py is the official Python client for Supabase. I fixed the realtime client so channels rejoin on the stepped backoff schedule (PR 1916) and landed one earlier fix (PR 1885).

projects.name: Python packaging and observability (contributor)
projects.description: Fixes in the libraries most Python projects depend on: pypa/distlib (merged, PR 289), pypa/packaging (bounding parenthesis nesting in license expressions, PR 1482, in review) and opentelemetry-python-contrib (tornado instrumentation test, PR 5219, in review).

channels.description: Direct transfer to an Indian bank account. Details shared by email.

plans.name: Three month open source contribution fellowship
plans.description: Rs 60,000 a month for three months of full time contribution. Month 1: land the two open LanceDB PRs (BloomFilter for Python, NGram for Node.js) and open PRs for the remaining index and query options missing from the SDKs. Month 2: get those merged with tests and docs, and land the open pypa/packaging and OpenTelemetry PRs. Month 3: four or more further merged fixes from open bug reports. Community: a monthly update on the FOSS United forum and one talk or blog post for first time contributors.
